items.question: Under Federal Law No. 6 of 2022 on juvenile delinquents, can a child under 12 years old be held criminally responsible for an offence?
items.gold: No, a child under 12 years old would not be held criminally responsible.
items.fact: Children under 12 are not criminally responsible under juvenile law

items.question: Under Federal Law No. 6 of 2022 on juvenile delinquents, what is the maximum detention period a court can impose on a juvenile in place of a death sentence or imprisonment?
items.gold: Detention for no more than 10 years.
items.fact: Juvenile detention replacing death or imprisonment capped at 10 years
